question: Should this PR be deferred entirely, or narrowed to non-mutating doctor-only experimental support until CUA exposes a trustworthy create-ownership primitive?
rationale: The supported upstream API cannot associate an ambiguous successful create with a Crabbox claim, so the permanent provider scope and acceptable resource-risk policy require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Defer the provider
options.body: Wait for upstream idempotency, client-assigned identity, or echoed request metadata plus credentialed zero-residue lifecycle proof before landing built-in support.

options.title: Keep doctor only
options.body: Remove create, run, retained reuse, archive transfer, stop, and cleanup while retaining explicitly experimental non-mutating SDK and authentication diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Defer the provider
recommendation.body: Wait for upstream idempotency, client-assigned identity, or echoed request metadata plus credentialed zero-residue lifecycle proof before landing built-in support.

likelyOwner.reason: He performed the latest lifecycle hardening and refreshed the current branch, making him the strongest available owner for this scope decision.
